_comment: NPCs added to maps beyond what Map.wz ships. Kept here rather than edited into the converted WZ JSON so that re-running tools/wz-to-json.js cannot silently delete them. Keyed by map id; each entry takes the same fields as a Map.wz 'life' node of type 'n'. Empty since 2026-08-21: the two Free Market additions (Maple Administrator 9010000, Maple Admin the Witness 9000030) were removed as non-GMS.
